article.title: Germany’s Merz admits ‘disaster’ in state elections, vows to press ahead with reforms
article.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Sunday described his CDU party's heavy losses in two regional elections as a "disaster", but vowed to push ahead with a reform drive. article.summary: Two German states are heading to the polls today – in Berlin and the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.
